chunks: He said: Abul Hasan Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Waleed, may Allah have mercy on him, reported to me from his father, who reported from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from al-Hasan ibn Mahboob, from Abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz, from Abu Hamza al-Thumali, from Abu Ja’far Muhammad ibn Ali, peace be upon them both, who said

My father Ali ibn al-Husayn, peace be upon them both, used to say: Four characteristics — whoever possesses them, his faith is complete, his sins are purified from him, and he meets his Lord while He is pleased with him: he who fulfils his obligations towards people for the sake of Allah, he whose tongue is truthful with people, he who feels ashamed of every ugly deed before Allah and before people, and he whose character is good with his family.

key_terms.استحيا من كل قبيح: Feels ashamed of every ugly deed — the Islamic concept of haya (modesty)
key_terms.كمل إيمانه: His faith is complete — reaching fullness of belief through moral excellence
key_terms.محصت ذنوبه: His sins are purified — cleansed through these virtues
key_terms.وفى لله: Fulfils for Allah — keeping obligations sincerely for God’s sake

ai.seo_question: What are the four characteristics that complete faith according to Imam al-Sajjad?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sajjad (Ali ibn al-Husayn, AS), as transmitted by his son Imam al-Baqir (AS), identifies four traits that complete faith, purify sins, and earn God’s pleasure: fulfilling commitments for God’s sake, truthfulness, shame before wrongdoing, and good character with family. This teaching was given in Medina in the early 2nd century AH.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 9. He said: Abul Hasan Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Waleed, may Allah bless him with mercy, reported to me from his father, who reported from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Abdul Jabbar, from al-Hasan ibn Mahboob, from Abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz, from Abu Hamza al-Thumali, who reported from Abu Ja’far Muhammad ibn ‘Ali, peace be upon him, who said:

My father ‘Ali ibn al-Husayn, peace be upon him, used to say that whoever has four characteristics in him, his faith will be deemed complete, and he will be purified of his sins, and he will meet his Lord having earned His pleasure: "He who fulfils his duty towards people for the sake of Allah, and he who is always truthful with people, and he who feels ashamed of committing any ugly deed before people and before Allah, and he who puts on the best behaviour with his family."
